elements.text: What the results justify doing next
Chandrayaan-3 terrain reconstruction  |  Detailed evidence: 10 Nov 2026

Priority	Deliverable	Evidence needed to proceed
1 · validity	Reject frozen/crossfade controls; retain frame indices	Per-cell parallax; deduplicated seed votes; fixed masks
2 · first learned return	Evaluate colleague’s ZIP with the same contract	Inputs, model/version, prompt, seed, frames, hashes
3 · broad benchmark	Run >10 distinct open/closed method families	Matched endpoints and resolution; failure + cost + quality
4 · sim → real test	Import actual completed OBJ into Blender / planner	Units/up verified; slopes, artifacts and edges inspected
5 · unknown terrain priors	Review segmentation and test controlled priors	Rock/crater labels; withheld validation; provenance
Select a method only after it improves the completed fixed reference region over interpolation.
